at: EN on behalf of the European Commission (26.11.2026) In the programming period 2021-2027, in the region of Crete, cohesion policy1 supports flood protection actions under the regional programme with some EUR 21.9 million. The region is benefiting from additional funding for flood protection actions from the sectoral programmes ‘Environment and Climate Change’2 with an allocation of some EUR 213 million and ‘Civil Protection’3 with some EUR 133 million. The EU Solidarity Fund (EUSF)4 can be activated at the request of Greece which has a deadline of 12 weeks as from when the first damage occurred, demonstrating that the total direct damage exceeds the thresholds specified in Article 2 of Regulation (EC) No 2012/2002. The EUSF may cover a part of the costs for emergency and recovery operations incurred by public authorities5. Private damage is not eligible, and agricultural damages cannot be reimbursed from the Fund. Under the common agricultural policy (CAP), Member States may provide support for restoring agricultural potential and compensation for loss of production following natural disaster, adverse climatic events or catastrophic events through their CAP Strategic Plans6. The Commission stands ready to provide support and guidance to the Greek authorities.
